an4.91:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro?
an4.91:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo parisā pi 'ssa hoti dussilā pāpadhammā.
an4.91:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro. 3.
an4.91:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro?
an4.91:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo parisā ca khvassa sīlavatī hoti kalyāṇadhammā.
an4.91:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro. 4.
an4.91:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro?
an4.91:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo parisā ca khvassa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
an4.91:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro. 5.
an4.91:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo devo hoti devaparivāro?
an4.91:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo parisā pi 'ssa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
an4.91:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo devo hoti devaparivāro.
an4.91:5.4: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 92.
